media_assets_dimensions_positive.name: media_assets_dimensions_positive
media_assets_dimensions_positive.value: ("media_assets"."width" IS NULL OR "media_assets"."width" > 0) AND ("media_assets"."height" IS NULL OR "media_assets"."height" > 0)

seats_row_label_uq.name: seats_row_label_uq
seats_row_label_uq.where: "seats"."row_id" IS NOT NULL AND "seats"."removed_at" IS NULL

seats_row_position_uq.name: seats_row_position_uq
seats_row_position_uq.where: "seats"."row_id" IS NOT NULL AND "seats"."removed_at" IS NULL

seats_table_position_uq.name: seats_table_position_uq
seats_table_position_uq.where: "seats"."table_element_id" IS NOT NULL AND "seats"."removed_at" IS NULL

seats_position_required.name: seats_position_required
seats_position_required.value: ("seats"."row_id" IS NULL AND "seats"."table_element_id" IS NULL) OR "seats"."position" IS NOT NULL

access_codes_ticket_limits.name: access_codes_ticket_limits
access_codes_ticket_limits.value: ("access_codes"."max_tickets_per_order" IS NULL OR "access_codes"."max_tickets_per_order" > 0) AND ("access_codes"."max_tickets_total" IS NULL OR "access_codes"."max_tickets_total" > 0)

access_codes_validity.name: access_codes_validity
access_codes_validity.value: "access_codes"."valid_from" IS NULL OR "access_codes"."valid_until" IS NULL OR "access_codes"."valid_from" < "access_codes"."valid_until"

events_presale_before_public.name: events_presale_before_public
events_presale_before_public.value: "events"."presale_starts_at" IS NULL OR "events"."public_sale_starts_at" IS NULL OR "events"."presale_starts_at" <= "events"."public_sale_starts_at"

events_positive_overrides.name: events_positive_overrides
events_positive_overrides.value:
COALESCE("events"."max_tickets_per_order", 1) > 0
        AND COALESCE("events"."max_tickets_per_customer", 1) > 0
        AND COALESCE("events"."cart_lock_ttl_seconds", 1) > 0
        AND COALESCE("events"."payment_grace_seconds", 0) >= 0
        AND COALESCE("events"."bank_transfer_payment_term_days", 1) > 0
        AND COALESCE("events"."bank_transfer_reminder_after_days", 1) > 0
        AND COALESCE("events"."bank_transfer_cancel_after_days", 1) > 0
        AND COALESCE("events"."bank_transfer_disable_days_before_event", 0) >= 0

fees_override_on_event.name: fees_override_on_event
fees_override_on_event.value: "fees"."overrides_fee_id" IS NULL OR "fees"."event_id" IS NOT NULL

queue_configs_positive.name: queue_configs_positive
queue_configs_positive.value:
"queue_configs"."active_session_threshold" > 0 AND "queue_configs"."admission_batch_size" > 0
        AND "queue_configs"."admission_interval_seconds" > 0 AND "queue_configs"."pass_token_ttl_seconds" >= 60
        AND "queue_configs"."lobby_opens_minutes_before" >= 0
        AND ("queue_configs"."max_queue_size" IS NULL OR "queue_configs"."max_queue_size" > 0)

customers_account_created.name: customers_account_created
customers_account_created.value: "customers"."password_hash" IS NULL OR "customers"."account_created_at" IS NOT NULL

orders_amounts_nonneg.name: orders_amounts_nonneg
orders_amounts_nonneg.value:
"orders"."subtotal_gross" >= 0 AND "orders"."discount_total" >= 0 AND "orders"."fee_total" >= 0
        AND "orders"."total_gross" >= 0 AND "orders"."total_net" >= 0 AND "orders"."total_tax" >= 0
        AND "orders"."amount_paid" >= 0 AND "orders"."amount_refunded" >= 0

orders_paid_at.name: orders_paid_at
orders_paid_at.value: "orders"."status" NOT IN ('PAID','REFUNDED','PARTIALLY_REFUNDED') OR "orders"."paid_at" IS NOT NULL

orders_awaiting_has_terms.name: orders_awaiting_has_terms
orders_awaiting_has_terms.value: "orders"."status" <> 'AWAITING_PAYMENT' OR ("orders"."payment_reference" IS NOT NULL AND "orders"."payment_due_at" IS NOT NULL)
